notes.title: Updates notes for December 26, 2021
notes.notes:
Fixes to the feat Never Been Better so it now will trigger correctly.

It also adds a sync between steam achievements and feats so if you for some reason did not get the achievement but got the feat, the game will automatically give you the achievement when joining a game with a character that has the feat unlocked.
